main_text.head: ΑΣ, ΗΣ, ΥΣ.
main_text.p: Definentia in ας, ης, & υς, formant comparativum & superlativum, addito τερ(G) & τατ(G) ad positivum neutrū. ut:
main_text.head: ΟΣ.
main_text.p: Definentia in ὡ, formant comparativum & superlativum à positivo, mutato ς in τερ(G) & τατ(G). idq;, vel retento o in antepenultimâ, si penultima positivi sit longa: vel mutato o in ω, si penultima positivi sit brevis aut anceps. ut:

page.notes: Greek forms are transcribed as best legible; several accented letters and the tilde/abbreviation forms (τερ(G), τατ(G) standing for the Greek endings -τερ- ω and -τατ- ος) are approximate. Marginal manuscript annotations (a red-brown mark at left of "Definentia" and ink smudges) are not printed text and are omitted. Line "ἁγιος" and some accents are doubtful.
